text:
mia: heads up — seeing what looks like missing child spans from microbatch prefetch runs at ~15:22 UTC, traces show a single parent span only.
ben: which service / trace id? any dashboard links?
mia: service=kvcache-prefetcher-prod, example trace: https://jaeger.internal.redwood.com/trace/4a1f2b9c — grafana panel: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/obs/kvcache-prefetcher-overview (look at spans_per_trace)
yousef: quick triage steps: 1) are pods using the new obs image with OTEL envs? 2) check logs for span-dropping errors 3) run `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=kvcache-prefetcher -c prefetcher --since=30m | rg "span"` to grep recent span messages
jamie: fyi we saw a similar pattern — Node OTEL SDK in image v1.2.3 defaulted to AlwaysOnSampler which blew up backend and then we started dropping spans. v1.2.4 switched to ParentBased(TraceIdRatio) by default.
mia: pods are on 1.2.3 still, rolling update stalled. temp mitigation: set envs on deployment to `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio` and `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.02` or upgrade to 1.2.4 that supports parentbased parsing
ben: small correction — our image v1.2.3 accepts `traceidratio` env only; `parentbased_traceidratio` parsing landed in 1.2.4. also you can enable `REDWOOD_OBS_VERBOSE_SPAN=true` to print drop reasons (helps debugging but noisy)
perf-bot: metric alert candidate: spans_per_trace.avg dropped >30% for 5m for any kvcache-* service — suggested threshold created in draft (https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/alert/alerts/2345)
yousef: I'll add a short runbook entry (wiki: https://wiki.redwood.com/obs/span-loss) and kick a canary rollout of 1.2.4 tomorrow morning; will also add a temporary alert for span_drop_rate > 0.05
mia: thanks — I'll patch the deployment with the env override now and watch the grafana panel, will ping when I see child spans return. :thumbsup:
